system.description:
[Trigger: Instant] You enter the [Riding: Amber Mountain Cat] status. While in the [Riding: Amber Mountain Cat] status, your [Magic Defense] is increased by +2, and you can use the EX Power "Beast Dash" and "Beast Jump". (CR11) This item has no effect. Small bell said to have been carved from a magic stone left behind by an old mountain cat. It can call a young mountain cat if it is jingled.

Ligurian Spirit Stone [Core Material] (30G) + Hollyhock Charm (60G) + [Magic Catalyst 1] (15G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (65G)
